# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step.

## About

Rohith is a self-taught developer who likes shipping things, performance work, and clean UIs. Outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino films. Based in Toronto. Open to collaboration.

Motto: *facta non verba* — deeds, not words.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html` file. Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no React, no bundler. Hosted on GitHub Pages.

Features: living-painting gallery (Wikimedia Commons), motion poster wall, orchestral background music (Tone.js generative synthesis, gesture-gated), contact section. Dark aesthetic, parchment grain, aged patina, manuscript frame.

## Sections

- **I · The Works** — projects: Crave (food marketplace, React/Node/Postgres), CryptoApp (live markets, React/WebSocket), Toronto (civic data, Python), NNets (neural nets from first principles, Python/Micrograd).
- **II · The Craft** — stack: JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GraphQL.
- **III · The Muses** — influences: Kill Bill, Pulp Fiction, Interstellar; A.R. Rahman, AC/DC, The Beatles.
- **IV · The Letter** — contact: email, GitHub, Twitter.

## FAQ

**Who is Rohith Illuri?**
A self-taught developer based in Toronto. Builds marketplace, data, and ML projects. Prefers small, deliberate software over large systems.

**What does he work on?**
Full-stack web (React + Node + Postgres), real-time data (WebSocket), civic-data analysis in Python, and neural networks built from first principles.

**How was this site built?**
A single hand-written HTML file. No React, no Vite, no bundler. Styled with CSS custom properties. Animated with CSS and a tiny inline script. Audio is generative Tone.js, gesture-gated. CSP, SRI, and `prefers-reduced-motion` honored.

**Is he open to work / collaboration?**
Yes. Reach him by email.
